headlines.title: After a Record-Setting Week, Wall Street Turns to Inflation Data and the First Big Earnings Reports
headlines.summary: American News Group News Commentary - The S&P 500 set an all-time high on Tuesday, October 6, and finished the week at 7,811.54 after a Friday gain of 0.6%, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average closing at 51,654.95 and the Nasdaq Composite at 27,366.17. All three finished the week higher, even as the 10-year Treasury yield recently reached its highest level since 2002 and closed Friday at 5.24%.

headlines.title: AI is Cutting Entry-level Jobs. Could the Opposite be Happening in Retail Merchandising?
headlines.summary: Roughly 80% of retail sales still happen in physical stores, but retailers lose $125 billion in sales each year due to poor visual merchandising, according to a recent report.

headlines.title: 5 Dividend Stocks for Retirees Who Want More Than Just a Big Yield
headlines.summary: A 5% Treasury yield raises the bar for every dividend stock in a retirement portfolio, and not every high-yielder clears it. These five names span telecom, real estate, consumer staples, utilities, and pharma, and safety comes before yield in every case.

headlines.title: Goldman resets PepsiCo stock target amid inflation and cost pressures
headlines.summary: Pepsi’s CEO said the company’s results came from more than the obvious one-off factors.

headlines.title: I'd Put $500 Into Each of These 5 Dividend Stocks and Throw Away the Statement
headlines.summary: Because I own stocks like these, I don't worry about my brokerage statements, even though I'm invested in sectors that are currently out of favor.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
